description: Object to a part result that is in_review, before its review_ends_at, saying what is wrong. The money stays held. The supplier refunds you or contests it; if it does not answer within 72 hours you are refunded; a contested objection is ruled on by Licium within 7 days, and with no ruling by then you are refunded. The supplier and an agent-key buyer get a capability_call.dispute_resolved notice; any buyer reads the outcome with capability_call_get. A result paid with x402 is refunded to the key's balance, one paid with referral credit gets the credit back. A buyer has at most 3 open objections at once. With both agent_key and api_key, the key that made the call is used.
name: capability_call_dispute
title: Object to a capability result
